name: Stagehand Browser
description: AI-native browser automation via Browserbase Stagehand — hosted and self-hosted MCP presets plus a /stagehand setup guide.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Opens the /stagehand setup guide modal that compares the hosted and self-hosted presets and links into MCP settings.
permissionJustifications.shell:execute: Runs `node --version` and `npx --version` when you press 'Check environment' in the /stagehand guide — the only two commands, both covered by shellCommands.

browser.reason: The self-hosted preset spawns @browserbasehq/mcp via npx, and the setup guide's environment check needs the desktop shell.

mobile.reason: The self-hosted preset spawns @browserbasehq/mcp via npx — unavailable on mobile.

mcpServerPresets.name: Stagehand — Hosted
mcpServerPresets.description: Browserbase's hosted Streamable-HTTP endpoint — no local Node.js, and the default Gemini model cost is covered. The API key goes in a request header so it is stored in the credential vault.

fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: Leave as-is for the default Gemini model. Optional query params: ?modelName=…&modelApiKey=…&keepAlive=true&proxies=true. A URL that carries modelApiKey is saved to the credential vault, not in plain text.

mcpServerPresets.name: Stagehand — Self-hosted
mcpServerPresets.description: AI-native browser automation (act / extract / observe / agent). Spawns @browserbasehq/mcp over stdio; sessions run on Browserbase cloud Chromium.

fields.label: Gemini API key (Stagehand model)
fields.description: Stagehand defaults to google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Pass --modelName plus --modelApiKey in the server args to use a different provider; the value after --modelApiKey is saved to the credential vault.

commands.name: /stagehand
commands.description: Open the Stagehand browser setup guide — compare hosted vs self-hosted presets and jump to the right gallery card.

en.manifest.name: Stagehand Browser
en.manifest.description: AI-native browser automation via Browserbase Stagehand — hosted and self-hosted MCP presets plus a /stagehand setup guide.
en.modal.title: Set up a Stagehand browser
en.modal.subtitle: Pick how the agent should drive a browser. Each option adds a Stagehand MCP server you can enable and attach to an agent.
en.modal.env.label: Environment — self-hosted only
en.modal.env.missing: Node.js or npx was not found. Install Node.js 18+ first.
en.modal.env.unavailable: Shell access is unavailable in this host, so the check cannot run.
en.modal.env.error: The check could not run — the command was denied or failed.
en.modal.env.hint: Only the self-hosted preset spawns `npx @browserbasehq/mcp` — Node.js 18+ must be on the PATH the app sees. The hosted option needs nothing local.
en.modal.afterAdd: A server added from a preset starts disabled — enable it, then attach it to an agent in the character editor.
en.mode.hosted.desc: Browserbase runs the MCP endpoint and the Chromium session for you — no local Node.js, and the default Gemini model cost is covered. The only credential is your API key, sent as a request header and stored in the credential vault.
en.mode.selfHosted.desc: Spawns @browserbasehq/mcp locally over stdio. Full flag control (--modelName, --proxies, --keepAlive, …) at the cost of a Node.js toolchain and three credentials.
en.req.threeKeys: API key + project ID + model key
en.command.opened: Opened the Stagehand browser setup guide.
en.commands.stagehand.description: Open the Stagehand browser setup guide — compare hosted vs self-hosted presets and jump to the right gallery card.

zh-CN.manifest.name: Stagehand 浏览器
zh-CN.manifest.description: 通过 Browserbase Stagehand 实现 AI 原生的浏览器自动化——托管与自托管 MCP 预设，以及 /stagehand 配置指南。
zh-CN.modal.title: 配置 Stagehand 浏览器
zh-CN.modal.subtitle: 选择让 Agent 驱动浏览器的方式。每种方式都会添加一个 Stagehand MCP 服务器，启用后可挂载到 Agent。
zh-CN.modal.env.label: 环境 —— 仅自托管需要
zh-CN.modal.env.missing: 未找到 Node.js 或 npx，请先安装 Node.js 18+。
zh-CN.modal.env.unavailable: 当前宿主不支持 Shell 访问，无法执行检查。
zh-CN.modal.env.error: 检查未能执行——命令被拒绝或运行失败。
zh-CN.modal.env.hint: 只有自托管预设会启动 `npx @browserbasehq/mcp`——应用进程的 PATH 中需要有 Node.js 18+。托管方式不需要任何本地环境。
zh-CN.modal.afterAdd: 通过预设添加的服务器默认处于停用状态——请先启用，再在角色编辑器中把它挂载到 Agent。
zh-CN.mode.hosted.desc: 由 Browserbase 运行 MCP 端点和 Chromium 会话——无需本地 Node.js，默认 Gemini 模型的费用由 Browserbase 承担。只需提供 API key（以请求头发送并存入凭证库）。
zh-CN.mode.selfHosted.desc: 在本地通过 stdio 启动 @browserbasehq/mcp。可以用全部 CLI 参数（--modelName、--proxies、--keepAlive 等），代价是需要 Node.js 工具链和三份凭证。
zh-CN.req.modelCovered: 默认模型费用已由平台承担
zh-CN.req.threeKeys: API key + 项目 ID + 模型 key
zh-CN.req.flags: 支持全部 CLI 参数
zh-CN.command.opened: 已打开 Stagehand 浏览器配置向导。
zh-CN.commands.stagehand.description: 打开 Stagehand 浏览器配置指南：比较托管与自托管预设并跳转到对应的图库卡片。
